title: grafana-ui cannot import @grafana/test-utils (circular dependency, lint-enforced)
answers: Why does eslint complain when I import @grafana/test-utils in a grafana-ui test?
What should I use instead of @grafana/test-utils in grafana-ui?
body: `eslint.config.js:281-294` defines rule `grafana/grafana-ui-no-test-utils` that blocks importing `@grafana/test-utils` from within grafana-ui, because that package depends back on `@grafana/ui`, creating a circular dependency. Use local DOM-only mocks in `packages/grafana-ui/src/test-utils/mockDom.ts` instead.
applies: Applies specifically to test files inside packages/grafana-ui/src/; other packages may use @grafana/test-utils freely.
